newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's 28-day TIIE rate rises to 20.28 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's 28-day TIIE rate rises to 20.28 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Monday, August 18, was fixed at 20.2800 percent, a rise of 11.50 basis points from 20.1650 percent on August 15, Banco de Mexico said Friday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day. It is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Monday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
